inputs.message: I was charged twice for my March invoice, please fix this today!!

evaluator.rubric: Output must be ONLY a JSON object with keys category (one of billing, how_to, bug, feature_request, security) and priority (one of low, medium, high, urgent), matching EXPECTED. No prose, no markdown fences. Full marks only for exact category and priority with valid bare JSON; deduct heavily for extra text, wrong labels or invented label names.
